questions.question: Approve a clarification of the twenty-move result: a 180-degree face turn counts as one move, as stated by the proof’s authors at https://www.cube20.org/ . The English rendering correctly means the symmetric group on 48 elements, not a group of order 48; approve equally explicit Russian wording.

localizations.source: Approve a clarification of the twenty-move result: a 180-degree face turn counts as one move, as stated by the proof’s authors at https://www.cube20.org/ . The English rendering correctly means the symmetric group on 48 elements, not a group of order 48; approve equally explicit Russian wording.
localizations.ru: Согласовать уточнение метрики результата о 20 ходах: поворот грани на 180° считается одним ходом. Это прямо указано авторами доказательства на https://www.cube20.org/ . В EN «симметрическая группа 48 элементов» передано как группа перестановок на 48 элементах, а не группа порядка 48; согласовать столь же однозначную RU формулировку.

questions.resolution: The sticker positions and the move metric are explicit in both editions, following [the proof of the twenty-move bound](https://www.cube20.org/).

questions.question: The source linked the cube’s invention specifically to explaining group theory; the 1967 qualification and historical institution names also required verification.

localizations.source: The source linked the cube’s invention specifically to explaining group theory; the 1967 qualification and historical institution names also required verification.
localizations.ru: В исходнике создание кубика связывалось именно с объяснением теории групп; требовалось также сверить квалификацию 1967 года и исторические названия учебных заведений.

questions.resolution: The motivation has been corrected using MIT Lemelson Center and MoMA material: Rubik used physical models when teaching construction and design and helped students think geometrically. His 1967 architecture degree and teaching at Budapest’s Academy of Applied Arts are also confirmed: https://lemelson.mit.edu/resources/erno-rubik ; https://www.moma.org/collection/works/2908 .

questions.question: Establish sources and dates for 350 million sales, one in three puzzles and six per cent of the population, and for the first-millionaire and restaurant-table claims. These belong to the historical 2024 post and have not been updated to the present.

localizations.source: Establish sources and dates for 350 million sales, one in three puzzles and six per cent of the population, and for the first-millionaire and restaurant-table claims. These belong to the historical 2024 post and have not been updated to the present.
localizations.ru: Нужны источники и временные рамки чисел «350 миллионов», «каждая третья головоломка» и «шесть процентов», а также утверждений о первом миллионере и сервировке ресторанных столов. Это сведения исторического поста 2024 года, они не обновлялись до текущего времени.
